sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (updated October 15, 2025)
sources.used_for: Section 5: the required statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' must be clearly and prominently stated on the site. Section 1: links must use the 'tagged' Special Link formats. Re-read 2026-11-14.

sources.title: Associates Central help: 'Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate?'
sources.used_for: Link-level disclosure must be 'clear' and 'conspicuous' and placed near each affiliate link or product review. The Operating Agreement statement must clearly and conspicuously appear on the site. Re-read 2026-11-14.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (updated April 14, 2026)
sources.used_for: Commission Income Statement §1 (Qualifying Purchases and Qualifying Revenue), §2(d)-(e) (search-engine and redirecting links); Participation Requirements §2(b) (tag in every link; prices only via Amazon-served link or Creators/PA API), §3(g), §3(t) (ratings only via Creators/PA API), §3(w) (link shortening), §5 (no ML use of Special Links or Program Content); IP License and Usage Requirements §1 (no data mining, robots, or LLM/ML use), §2(e) (no ML training use of API data). Re-read 2026-11-14.

sources.used_for: Disclosure must be 'hard to miss', placed with the endorsement, in simple and clear language; a material connection includes a financial relationship. Re-read 2026-11-14.
